_doc: ElevenLabs narrators for Stories X-Ray (designed 16/11/2026 in the owner's ElevenLabs account). voice.py rotates them by video number unless script.json sets "voice". Never put the API key here: it comes from the ELEVENLABS_API_KEY environment variable.
make_scenario: XR-07-ELEVENLABS-TTS (org 4863740, team 1249080, on-demand; inputs voice_id, out_name, payload_b64)

xr1.name: XR Narrator 1 - Campfire Maniac
xr1.style: American man, late 30s, warm raspy campfire storyteller: conspiratorial whispers, bursts of disbelief

xr2.name: XR Narrator 2 - Unhinged Podcaster
xr2.style: American woman, late 20s, hyperactive weird-history podcaster: rapid-fire, shrieks, nervous laughs, dead-serious whispers (the craziest one)

xr3.name: XR Narrator 3 - Porch Legend
xr3.style: Deep South man, late 50s, gravelly porch storyteller: slow raspy whispers, booming laughs and shouts

xr4.name: XR Narrator 4 - Absolute Lunatic
xr4.style: American man, early 40s, the most theatrical: booming gleeful roars to tiny trembling whispers, manic giggles, stretched words (designed 17/11 by XR-08)

xr5.name: XR Narrator 5 - Breathless Hype Host
xr5.style: American woman, mid 30s, breathless game-show/sports play-by-play energy: rapid-fire builds to shrieks, dead-silent pauses, gasps, cackles (designed 17/11 by XR-08)

xr6.name: XR Narrator 6 - Total Meltdown
xr6.style: American man, early 40s, even wilder than xr4: roaring gleeful shouts to trembling whispers, manic giggles, stretched vowels, breathless rushes, wheezing excitement (designed 17/11 by XR-08)

xr7.name: XR Narrator 7 - Queens Firecracker
xr7.style: American woman, mid 30s, thick fast Queens New York accent: shrieks, cackles, dramatic whispers then explodes (designed 18/11 by XR-08, owner asked for regional accents)

xr8.name: XR Narrator 8 - Southie Hothead
xr8.style: American man, early 40s, comedic Boston accent: roaring laughs, sudden shouts, trembling whispers, wheezing giggles (designed 18/11 by XR-08)

xr9.name: XR Narrator 9 - Texas Tornado
xr9.style: American woman, late 20s, big bright Texas drawl: squeals, honking laughs, slow suspense whispers snapping into fast shouting (designed 18/11 by XR-08)

_rotation_note: Owner preference 17/11/2026: xr4 'Absolute Lunatic' (used in xr007) is the favourite style (crazy, exalted) -> it appears twice in the rotation (weight). xr3 Porch Legend retired from rotation (voice kept). Duplicates in rotation are weights. 18/11/2026: owner asked to test hyper-histrionic male AND female voices, some with funny US regional accents -> added xr7 (Queens NY woman), xr8 (Boston man), xr9 (Texas woman). Order set so xr013/xr014/xr015 (13,14,15 mod 9 = 4,5,6) use the three new voices first.
